{{Spell_InfoBox|image=Bi'an Flying Sword.png|type=Spell Passive|rarity=Unique|dmg1=42|crit_rate1=20%|spell_slots1=+1}}
'''Bi'an Flying Sword''' is an [[Rarity|Unique]] [[Spells|Spell]] of Type: Spell Passive. When casting with the [[Wands|wand]], it automatically launches flying swords.

For every 25 Max MP on the wand, the flying sword limit is increased by 1.

Swords can only be recalled using the Bi'an [[Relics|relic]].
